info.title: Diet App API
info.description: What the API of Diet App is asked and what it answers. Written by `npm run contract` from the controllers and from the schemas of `@diet-app/shared`; the integration tests hold every answer to the schema its route names here.

get.summary: Who may use the operator's AI provider (`AI_ADMIN_ACCESS`), and how many accounts are approved for it.
get.description:
Who may use the operator's AI provider (`AI_ADMIN_ACCESS`), and how many accounts are approved for it.

Asked by the administrator.

put.summary: Approve the account of an address for the operator's AI provider.
put.description:
Approve the account of an address for the operator's AI provider. It counts while `AI_ADMIN_ACCESS` is `approved`. Approving it again changes nothing; an address without an account is 404.

Asked by the administrator.

Limited to 30 in a minute, for each sender.

204.description: Done; the answer has no body.

delete.summary: Take the approval of the account of an address back.
delete.description:
Take the approval of the account of an address back. An address without an account is 404.

Asked by the administrator.

Limited to 30 in a minute, for each sender.

204.description: Done; the answer has no body.

delete.summary: Take the second factor off the account of an address: for a holder who lost the authenticator app and the recovery codes.
delete.description:
Take the second factor off the account of an address: for a holder who lost the authenticator app and the recovery codes. The account signs in with its password alone afterwards, and is told so by mail. Whether the one who asks is the holder is for the operator to make sure of.

Asked by the administrator.

Limited to 10 in a minute, for each sender.

204.description: Done; the answer has no body.

get.summary: What the API sees of the connection the administrator is on.
get.description:
